_about: What's new in each version of Manifexus, newest first. Shown in Updates. Write for people, not developers: short, plain sentences about what they can now do.

releases.headline: Meet Ask Manifexus: a private AI, built in, that can look into problems and fix them with your OK.
new: Ask Manifexus. Tap Ask in the header and ask anything about your apps: why something stopped, what changed, what's using the most memory.
It runs on your own server. It's free and private, and nothing leaves your network.
Picked for your server. Manifexus checks your memory, processor and graphics card, and recommends AI models that fit without slowing your apps down.
Downloads that don't give up. If the connection drops, the AI download picks up where it stopped, even after a restart. Every download is checked before it's used.
Fix with AI. One tap from the To Fix list in Diagnostics, and it works out what's wrong.
You're always in control. Every change is shown to you first, with a before and after of every file. It's backed up, and you can undo it from Restore.
Choose how much it may do on its own: Look Only, Ask Before Changes, Fix Routine Things or Expert.
improved: Updates now show version numbers and notes like these, instead of build codes.
Activity has a new Fixes filter.
fixed: On phones, the dashboard no longer shifts sideways by a few pixels.
If an AI model can't download, you get a clear reason and a Try Again button.

releases.headline: The first full release: move, restore and understand your Docker apps, all in one place.
new: Restore. Go back to before any move or delete. Every change keeps a backup, and restores can be undone too.
Activity. A complete record of everything Manifexus does, with the exact reason when something fails.
Diagnostics. Health checks in plain words, with a To Fix list that stays until each issue is fixed.
App Details. Every app's health, resources, storage, network and what it has printed, in one place.
Software updates that restore the previous version automatically if the new one doesn't start.
improved: One clean, consistent design throughout, with every screen the same size.
Settings save as you change them.
fixed: A leftover app entry in one stack can no longer break moving apps into it.
